about_the_game: Clawsome! is a game of skill and precision where you control a claw to grab prizes… but the environment won’t make it easy! Inspired by the thrill (and frustration) of claw machines, you’ll face moving obstacles, disappearing platforms, sudden pushes, and prizes that seem to have a mind of their own. Every object you collect becomes part of your customizable diorama, letting you create a collection of absurd and hilarious moments. Test your dexterity and prove you have the best claw ever!

short_description: Control a claw in a chaotic world where grabbing prizes is harder than it looks! Avoid moving platforms, disappearing objects, and unexpected twists while building your own diorama with the trophies you collect.
